newsitem.title: GERMANY: DePfa says UBS may hold 9 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: DePfa says UBS may hold 9 pct stake.

text.p: German mortgage bank DePfa-Bank AG said on Tuesday that inquiries of an independent corporation specialised in identifying shareholders indicated that Switzerland's UBS-Group had purchased a substantial part of Depfa-Bank's capital in the open market.
"This leads to the conclusion that UBS-Group holds approximately nine percent of DePfa-Bank's equities at this moment," DePfa said in a mandatory statement.
DePfa said UBS had so far not informed it of any such shareholding and that DePfa had on Monday asked the UBS management for written comments.
"They informed DePfa by fax yesterday evening that 'the positions analysed by them are clearly under one percent...within UBS-Group...'," DePfa said, citing the reply from UBS.
DePfa added that UBS had told it that due to time constraints the analysis was limited to Europe and that no indications of a substantial participation of UBS were discernable.
DePfa said that it had decided to make an announcement on the matter for the sake of its shareholders and against the background of legal obligations.

It also said it had found that UBS was "related" to Schweizerische Lebensversicherungs- und Rentenanstalt A.G., one of the core members of DePfa-Holding Verwaltungsgesellschaft GmbH, a holding company which owns 40 percent of DePfa's capital.
The remaining 60 percent of DePfa's capital is widely distributed.
